Recommendation: do not treat 'Krishi Viman' and 'UAVGARAGE PRIVATE LIMITED' as the same verified supplier until the link is documented; the only hard, dated, B/L-level evidence in this batch belongs to UAVGARAGE and it is inbound cargo.
